result.title: Learning Size Independent Constraint Models from Input Data and Positive and Negative Example Solutions
result.summary: In this paper we describe a Constraint Acquisition Tool that generates size independent constraint programs from input data and positive and negative example solutions of multiple problem instances. The system finds size specific models based on typical constraint patterns over global and binary constraints, then generalizes the models to a size independent model that can be run on unseen input data. The system produces MiniZinc code as well as a textual description of the model. We evaluate the tool on the example problems of the PTHG21 Challenge and show the feasibility of the approach.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出一个约束获取工具，从多个问题实例的输入数据及正、负示例解中，先在具体规模上找出基于全局约束与二元约束的典型模式，再泛化为可运行于未见数据的规模无关模型，输出 MiniZinc 代码与文本描述，并在 PTHG21 挑战题上验证可行性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「由具体规模模型泛化为 size-independent 模型」与 LVR 关注的长度／规模泛化可能构成概念类比，而利用正负例归纳并筛出约束假设的过程，或可供核查作为推理状态的抽象与验证框架的参照。
